title: Consultation and communications records behind the W013609 extension, GovQA Audit History for W013534 and W013609, and the "communications query" search record
summary:
Asks for records about how the Department handled W013534-092926 and W013609-100926, for 2026-09-29 through the request date. The request quotes the City's 2026-10-19 extension notice on W013609, which took 14 days under Gov. Code § 7922.535(c) for "consultation ... with another agency having substantial interest in the determination of the request or among two or more components of the agency" without saying which, and the 2026-10-23 response letter's statement that records "were identified during our communications query."

- Item 1: all communications between City or Department employees and anyone outside the City about either request, or about any request for or disclosure of records relating to case number R3-23-0055, on City and personal accounts and devices used for City business (City of San Jose v. Superior Court (2017) 2 Cal.5th 608). Proposes search terms (W013534, W013609, R3-23-0055, R3230055) in the accounts of each employee who processed either request or took part in the consultation, and notes that a "no responsive records" answer would mean either an internal-only consultation or an outside consultation that left no written record.
- Item 2: any record identifying the agency or Department components consulted, the dates, and any position, objection or request received from a consulted agency.
- Item 3: the GovQA request activity history ("Audit History") for both requests, in the format the City produced for 30 requests under W012790-052526.
- Item 4: the record of the "communications query": the accounts searched, search terms, date range and item count.

Withheld portions are to be marked in place, field by field, with the exemption relied on (Gov. Code §§ 7922.525(b), 7922.540); records withheld in full are to be named with their exemption; and the Department is asked to say so for any responsive record it says another agency holds. The request states it is separate from W013534, W013609 and any rolling production of monthly audit logs.

policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department identifies who was consulted for the W013609 extension and produces the records of that consultation (wording as quoted in the City's 10/19 notice).

policy_promises.tests: Whether the item 1 search covers personal accounts and devices used for City business.

prior_pra_refs.note: Request whose 10/19 extension cited consultation under § 7922.535(c) and whose 10/23 letter referred to a "communications query"; this request asks for the records of that consultation and query.
Earlier single-search request in the same series; its GovQA Audit History and related outside communications are also requested.
The City produced GovQA Audit History for 30 requests under this request; item 3 asks for the same format.

filed_because: The Department extended W013609 by 14 days for a consultation it did not describe, then closed the request without saying who was consulted. Its letter also relied on a "communications query" without saying what was searched. This request asks for the consultation records, the request-handling logs for both requests, and the search record behind the query.
notes: Filed 2026-10-26 (portal receipt 10/26/2026 6:29 PM); auto-acknowledged and forwarded to department(s). 10-day statutory determination due 2026-11-05.
